talks.speaker: Gerrit W. Gong
talks.title: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
talks.summary: Elder Gong shares foundational doctrine about the house of the Lord that can enrich our personal temple culture.

talks.speaker: Tamara W. Runia
talks.title: The Sculpting of Our Souls
talks.summary: Sister Runia teaches that God is intimately aware of your experience and has a plan for you.

talks.speaker: Gérald Caussé
talks.title: The Gift of Testimony
talks.summary: Elder Caussé teaches that a testimony of Jesus Christ is a personal gift of the Spirit and that we should each seek opportunities to share it.

talks.speaker: Vaiangina Sikahema
talks.title: Prophets, Seers, and Revelators
talks.summary: Elder Sikahema teaches how important it is to listen to and follow the words of our prophets and apostles.

talks.speaker: Kevin J. Hathaway
talks.title: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
talks.summary: Elder Hathaway teaches that if we turn to Jesus Christ, He can deliver us from our afflictions.

talks.speaker: Ulisses Soares
talks.title: A Higher and Holier Fast
talks.summary: Elder Soares teaches that observing the law of the fast is an act of worship that shapes and refines our discipleship and draws us closer to the Lord.

talks.speaker: Sean Douglas
talks.title: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
talks.summary: Bishop Douglas invites the rising generation to follow the counsel of modern prophets and serve missions.

talks.speaker: D. Todd Christofferson
talks.title: O Be Wise
talks.summary: President Christofferson teaches about the dangers of gambling and encourages us to use our time to do good.

talks.speaker: Dale G. Renlund
talks.title: “How Long Will It Be Ere They Believe Me?”
talks.summary: Elder Renlund teaches that remembering God’s goodness and trusting His promises can help us find joy and peace through Jesus Christ, even amid life’s challenges.

talks.speaker: Timothy L. Farnes
talks.title: Divine Appointments
talks.summary: President Farnes teaches that as covenant followers of Jesus Christ, we should see the person before us with compassion rather than judgment and then act.

talks.speaker: Christian C. Chigbundu
talks.title: Spiritual Immunity
talks.summary: Elder Chigbundu teaches that scripture study, prayer, the sacrament, and covenants can help us withstand life’s challenges.

talks.speaker: Patricio M. Giuffra
talks.title: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
talks.summary: Elder Giuffra teaches about the blessings of obeying the law of tithing, even in difficult financial circumstances.

talks.speaker: Jeremiah J. Morgan
talks.title: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
talks.summary: Elder Morgan teaches that covenants with God have great power and affect not only us but also our posterity across generations.

talks.speaker: Hutch U. Fale
talks.title: I Am a Child of God
talks.summary: Elder Fale teaches that we are all beloved children of God and we will be blessed as we follow His plan.

talks.speaker: Patrick Kearon
talks.title: Jesus Lives to Lift
talks.summary: Elder Kearon teaches that Jesus Christ will be our spiritual lift as we turn to Him.

talks.speaker: Michael A. Dunn
talks.title: The Ninety and Ten
talks.summary: Using the story of a friend helping him finish a race, Elder Dunn testifies of the ways Jesus Christ ministers to us in the journey of life.

talks.speaker: Matthew J. Eyring
talks.title: Comfort from the Holy Ghost
talks.summary: Elder Eyring teaches that as we turn to Jesus Christ, we can receive peace, hope, and comfort through the Holy Ghost.

talks.speaker: Ronald A. Rasband
talks.title: Love Like Jesus
talks.summary: Elder Rasband teaches that those with wayward children should turn their feelings of despair over to Jesus Christ, since He is the one who can change the hearts of those who have gone astray.

talks.speaker: Henry B. Eyring
talks.title: “Fear Not, I Am with Thee”
talks.summary: President Eyring teaches that our loving Heavenly Father will help us during our challenges.

talks.speaker: Rosemary K. Chibota
talks.title: A Child of God
talks.summary: President Chibota invites us to see others as children of God and to treat them as He would.

talks.speaker: Neil L. Andersen
talks.title: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
talks.summary: Elder Andersen shares many examples of people who had the courage to manifest their faith in Jesus Christ.

talks.speaker: James G. O. Fantone
talks.title: Take Upon Us His Name
talks.summary: Elder Fantone teaches that taking the Savior’s name upon us means covenanting to serve Him and our fellow beings throughout our lives.

talks.speaker: Edward Dube
talks.title: Come unto Christ
talks.summary: Elder Dube teaches that we can invite people to come unto Christ and do their best so that He can perfect them through His grace.

talks.speaker: Quentin L. Cook
talks.title: Integrity and Virtue Lead to Happiness
talks.summary: Elder Cook teaches that lifelong disciples of Jesus Christ best reflect the Savior’s teaching and direction when they joyfully live lives of integrity and virtue.

talks.speaker: Alfred Kyungu
talks.title: Using the Language of Peacemakers
talks.summary: Elder Kyungu teaches that we can be peacemakers by using language that is kind and respectful.

talks.speaker: Ciro Schmeil
talks.title: Consider Your Ways, and from This Day Will the Lord Bless You
talks.summary: Elder Schmeil teaches that our Savior and our covenants are essential to guide us through the covenant path and help us overcome our challenges and weaknesses.

talks.speaker: Dallin H. Oaks
talks.title: The Gospel of Jesus Christ Is for All
talks.summary: President Oaks teaches that the gospel of Jesus Christ is for all people and encourages us to come unto Christ and trust in His promises.

talks.speaker: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
talks.title: Christ-Centered Unity
talks.summary: President Uchtdorf teaches how we can become united in Christ as a community of Saints.

talks.speaker: Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
talks.title: God Is at Your Side
talks.summary: Drawing inspiration from the thirteenth article of faith, Sister Spannaus invites young women to create a list of aspirations, testifying that the Lord will guide and help them.

talks.speaker: Moisés Villanueva
talks.title: “Prove Me Now Herewith”
talks.summary: Elder Villanueva teaches that the Lord will bless us in subtle but significant ways when we obey the law of tithing.

talks.speaker: David A. Bednar
talks.title: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
talks.summary: Elder Bednar teaches about the importance of ordinances and covenants in our journey back to our Heavenly Father.

talks.speaker: Thabo Lebethoa
talks.title: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
talks.summary: Elder Lebethoa teaches three ways that we can feel the Savior’s influence more in our lives.

talks.speaker: Paul H. Sinclair
talks.title: Quick to Help, Slow to Judge
talks.summary: Elder Sinclair uses the story of Jesus and the woman at the well to encourage us to help and bless people rather than judging them.

talks.speaker: Gary E. Stevenson
talks.title: Fruit to Make One Happy
talks.summary: Elder Stevenson describes three fruits of the gospel of Jesus Christ and encourages children to share those fruits with others.

talks.speaker: Gabriel W. Reid
talks.title: You Are Good Enough to Teach
talks.summary: Brother Reid testifies that loving the Lord and loving those we teach is at the heart of gospel teaching.

talks.speaker: Clark G. Gilbert
talks.title: Teach Truth with Love
talks.summary: Elder Gilbert teaches about showing love to our neighbors while standing firm in our testimony of truth.

talks.speaker: Dallin H. Oaks
talks.title: Closing Remarks
talks.summary: President Oaks teaches us to focus on the Savior’s teachings, invites us to study the conference messages, and welcomes the world to the upcoming Salt Lake Temple Celebration.
